description: This file defines classes and methods for indexing ContentPickerField data within OrchardCore, specifically implementing ContentFieldIndexProvider for SQL indexing.

classes.name: ContentPickerFieldIndex
classes.description: Represents an index for ContentPickerField with a property for the selected content item ID.

classes.name: ContentPickerFieldIndexProvider
classes.description: Provides indexing logic for ContentPickerField, implementing Describe method to map content items to index entries.

methods.name: Describe(DescribeContext<ContentItem>)
methods.description: Defines how content items are mapped to index entries, filtering out deleted or ignored types, and indexing ContentPickerField data.
